legacy_test_tuning: Historical release_v1 was tuned on official test clips and is not a valid generalization benchmark.
unknown_legacy_sources_excluded: Roboflow person/clothing crops are not reused in the new dataset.
new_initializations: Fresh Kinetics600 / random for MoViNet; fresh COCO / random for YOLO. No legacy fine-tuned checkpoint is used as initialization.
